title: Are Metro Manila's heaviest rainfall days getting heavier?
pitch: 86 years of daily rainfall over Metro Manila, tested for intensifying extremes — the answer is no, and the trend that is significant is the one to distrust.
headline: Total annual rainfall is rising (p = 0.0001) but the wettest day of the year shows no trend (p = 0.4379) — Manila rains more often, not harder
